svg.title: Diagram of what USPS Postal Store pages say about free shipping supplies. What is listed: Priority Mail, Priority Mail Flat Rate and Priority Mail Express boxes and envelopes, labels, forms, customs pouches, military supplies and cremated remains kits, shown at no cost. The rule: the packaging is free when you pay for the matching service and may only be used to ship that way; international use is charged at the international price. Ordering: items come in packs, quantity maximums differ by item, orders ship by Ground Advantage with an expected delivery of 2 to 5 business days at no cost, after about one business day, and a separate phone line takes supply orders. The pages differ on the Dual-Use tube, the APO/FPO box and shipping time, and similar prepaid boxes are not free.
svg.text: USPS Free Shipping Supplies
What the Postal Store pages say
1. What the listing includes
Priority Mail, Flat Rate and Priority Mail
Express boxes and envelopes; labels; forms;
customs pouches; military supplies; cremated
remains kits. Shown at no cost.
2. The rule on the product pages
Free when you pay for the matching service
and only to be used to ship that way.
International use is charged at the
international price for that service.
3. Ordering and delivery
Items come in packs; quantity maximums
differ by item. Ships by Ground Advantage,
expected 2 to 5 business days (FAQ), no cost,
after about one business day. Supply orders
Where the pages differ
Dual-Use tube: no free-when-you-pay rule
and a size fee. APO/FPO box: no rule either.
Similar prepaid boxes are not free. Time to
ship: one business day, or 5-7 business days
in the product description.
Sources: Postal Store pages; USPS FAQ;
USPS.com Contact Us; read Nov. 26-27, 2026
